Name: Person User Information ID
Description: Supply the user key attributes.

Name: Person Number
Description: The person number of the person whose user information this is.

Name: User Name
Description: The user name to use if you are creating a user record or using user-name matching.

Name: Person ID
Description: A unique reference to the person whose user information this is.

Name: Create User If No Matching E-mail
Description: Indicates if a new user should be created if the e-mail address of the worker does not match the e-mail address of any existing user. Only used when the EmailMatchingFlag is set to true.

Name: Credentials E-mail Address
Description: The e-mail address to send the user name and password credentials to, instead of the default e-mail address.

Name: E-mail Address
Description: The e-mail address to use for e-mail matching.

Name: E-mail Matching
Description: Indicates whether an attempt should be made to look for an existing user with the value supplied in the EmailAddress attribute. If a user is found with this e-mail address, it will be associated with the worker and a new user account is not be created. If the UserGUID attribute is provided then e-mail matching will not be performed, as matching on the UserGUID takes precedence.

Name: Generated User Account
Description: Indicates if a user account should be created or not. If not set a user account will be generated.

Name: Send Credentials E-mail
Description: Indicates whether to send a user-name and password notification.

Name: Start Date
Description: The start date of the user information.

Name: User Globally Unique ID
Description: If provided a new user account will not be created. Instead the worker will be associated with the user account identified by the user's GUID. The GUID is available from LDAP.

Name: User Name Matching
Description: Indicates whether to associate this worker with the user account specified on the UserName attribute. Valid values are Y and N.

Name: Reference Context
Description: The context for the user-defined references provided for this component. Don't supply values for this attribute, instead specify the context against this attribute in the METADATA line using the format: SourceRefTableName= context. For example: SourceRefTableName=Store Information.

Name: Reference 1
Description: A user-defined reference value used for reporting and reconciling your data in the staging tables. This information is not saved in the application. You name your reference on the METADATA line using the format Attribute name = Reference name. For example, SourceRef001=Assignment Number.
